verdicts.reason: A is a jumbled layout. The NEW FLAVOR pill and the headline are jammed against the top edge, and the CTA crowds the two-line subcopy. The SOLSTICE wordmark is missing or reduced to a speck, the can is tiny and clipped at the bottom, and the right third is dead space. B reads cleanly from left to right (badge, logo, can, headline, subcopy, CTA) and the headline stands out, but the subcopy is squeezed into a tiny five-line column with orphaned words ('golden', 'hour.'). The wordmark is also too small to read, and the can is undersized.
